about.title: 🌟 About Me
paragraphs: Hello! I am Han Xiao (肖汉), a fourth-year Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science and Technology at [Southwest Jiaotong University](https://swjtu.edu.cn/), where I am fortunate to be advised by Prof. [Penglin Dai](https://itsgroups.github.io/). I have published papers in leading conferences and journals, including AAAI 2026, AAAI 2025, NeurIPS 2025, TMM, TITS, and INS.
My research lies at the intersection of computer vision and intelligent transportation, with a primary focus on the following areas:

points.label: Autonomous Driving
points.description: topics related to Collaborative Perception, and Cooperative Driving Automation.

about.note: 📬 Please feel free to send me an email if you are interested in discussing or working together. My email is [wqm@my.swjtu.edu.cn](mailto:wqm@my.swjtu.edu.cn)!
